research_question: Does aligning training and scoring more closely with the customer-level label provide an advantage that cannot be explained solely by unequal windows per customer or mean-probability aggregation?
causal_limit: SGCC has no temporal theft-event truth. These controls cannot identify temporal window-label noise.

features.definition: Exact frozen Stage 14 behavioural summaries of each usable 30-day window.

WINDOW_HGB_UNWEIGHTED.target: customer FLAG propagated to each window; proxy only

WINDOW_HGB_CUSTOMER_BALANCED.target: customer FLAG propagated to each window; proxy only
WINDOW_HGB_CUSTOMER_BALANCED.sample_weight: N_windows / (N_customers * n_i) for every window of customer i; equal total customer weight and mean window weight 1

W_LOGIT.target: customer FLAG propagated to each window; proxy only
W_LOGIT.customer_score: arithmetic mean of window probabilities, required by the Stage 20B instruction

C_LOGIT.customer_vector: arithmetic mean of the shared transformed 17-dimensional window vectors

shared_logistic_preprocessing.definition: Weighted mean and population variance fitted on DEV_TRAIN windows with customer-balanced weights; identical centering/scaling applied to both arms; zero scales replaced by 1.
shared_logistic_preprocessing.note: The explicit Stage 20B request fixes W_LOGIT scoring as mean probability; therefore exact linear mean-logit equivalence is not claimed.

aggregation_panel.selection: All four reported equally; no winning rule selected; MEAN is the historical primary reference.

metrics.threshold_status: Fixed at 0.5 before scoring; descriptive only; not used for the formulation decision.

practical_evidence_rule.clear_material_improvement: Both observed primary deltas positive, both paired 95% lower bounds above zero, and ROC-AUC delta >= 0.01 or AP delta >= 0.02.
practical_evidence_rule.aggregation_substantial: The same alternative rule meets clear material improvement versus MEAN in both HGB arms.

decision_policy.A: Only customer multiplicity meets the clear material improvement rule.
decision_policy.B: Only aggregation choice meets the substantial aggregation rule.
decision_policy.C: Only C_LOGIT minus W_LOGIT meets the clear material improvement rule.
decision_policy.D: None of A/B/C is supported and C_LOGIT fails to improve both observed primary metrics; the historical direct-customer advantage appears primarily representational.
decision_policy.E: More than one mechanism is supported, or the remaining pattern is mixed/inconclusive.

prohibited_adaptations: No hyperparameter tuning, feature discovery, aggregation selection, threshold tuning, class balancing, SMOTE, GAN, pseudo temporal labels, multiple-instance learning, or post-hoc comparison invention.
Do not reuse historically incompatible Stage 14 fitted models.
Do not load CONFIRMATION or FINAL_TEST features, labels, predictions, or performance.
Do not alter the frozen Stage 17B detector.
